requirements.invariant: Recovery writes are locally transactional; cross-system recovery uses intent/receipt/reconciliation and never claims distributed ACID.
External side effects are never executed as part of pure orchestration replay.
Every retriable effectful operation has stable effect/idempotency identity or a queryable reconciliation contract.
The same idempotency key with materially different intent is rejected as a semantic conflict.
UNKNOWN, PENDING, or DIVERGED external effects block replay when repetition could duplicate or contradict external state.
A confirmed-applied effect is consumed through its receipt without reissuing the external operation.
